verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is an open-source CLI that users install and run on their own machines. The docs cover a wide range of install methods (opentofu-docs-2) and an official OCI container image (opentofu-docs-39), the source and nightly builds are public on GitHub (opentofu-gh-3), and the Linux Foundation pledges it will stay truly open source (opentofu-docs-26, opentofu-docs-40). Community reports of consultancies migrating client projects (opentofu-comm-10, opentofu-comm-7) confirm it is run in practice. Missing for 10: the specific license is not named in the evidence, and there is no dedicated self-hosting or air-gapped deployment guide.
